description: Get recent earthquakes from EMSC (European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre): the last N days above a minimum magnitude, newest first. Convenience wrapper over the FDSN event API. Global coverage, strong in Europe/Mediterranean. Times are UTC ISO 8601, depth in km. Example: recent_earthquakes({ days: 7, minmag: 4 }).

days.description: How many days back to look (default: 7).

name: recent_earthquakes
title: Recent Earthquakes
